items.title: 9.5 Computing ke akhlaqi, qanooni aur mahoolyati asraat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ethical, legal and environmental impacts of computing (PDF 135-137).

blocks.text: Computing rozmarra zindagi par kai tarah asar dalti hai: is ke akhlaqi ya ghair-akhlaqi asraat, qanooni ya ghair-qanooni nataij, aur mahol par asar ho sakta hai. Akhlaqi istemal ka matlab munsifana, zimmedarana intikhab; qanooni istemal technology ke qawaneen ki pairwi; aur mahoolyati asar mein tawanai ka istemal aur electronic kachra shamil hain. In ka shaoor logon ko bakhabar, zimmedarana faisle karne deta hai.
Akhlaqi istemal ka matlab zimmedari se amal aur nuqsan se parhez hai: raazdari aur insaf ka ehtram aur maloomat ka theek istemal, faislon ke logon, idaron aur muashre par asraat dekhte hue.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Ijazat ke baghair online mawad copy karna copyright qanoon aur digital akhlaqiyat dono tor sakta hai.

items: Intellectual property: zehan ki takhleeqat, jaise software, music, kitabein, tasaveer, videos, designs aur ijadaat, jin ke qanooni malik afraad ya idare hain. Ijazat ke baghair copy, share ya use na kar ke, aur hawala de kar is ka ehtram karein.
Data ki milkiyat: zaati maloomat par control ka haq. Zaati aur hassas data mehfooz rakhna aur ghalat istemal se bachana zaroori hai.
Ghair-akhlaqi rawaiya: hacking, jhooti khabrein phailana aur cyberbullying nuqsan pohanchate, saakh bigarte aur qanooni saza la sakte hain; chhote online amal bhi bare asraat rakh sakte hain.

blocks.text: Qanooni pehlu aur data privacy ke qawaneen

Computing ke qanooni pehlu woh qawaid hain jo technology aur digital maloomat par lagu hote hain. Cybercrime computers, networks ya Internet se ghair-qanooni sargarmi hai, jaise hacking, shanakht ki chori aur online dhoka-dahi. Qawaneen afraad, idaron aur muashre ko data ke ghalat istemal se bachate, aur data privacy ke qawaneen yaqeeni banate hain ke zaati aur hassas maloomat zimmedari se jama, mehfooz aur share ho.

blocks.caption: Do ahem qawaneen
rows: Idare zaati data kaise jama, mehfooz aur use karein us ke qawaid; shaffafiyat aur ijazat lazmi, aur logon ko apna data dekhne ya mitane ka haq. Bohat se mulk aur companies isi jaise miyar apnati hain.

Cybercrime ke khilaf bunyadi qanoon, afraad, idaron aur riyasat ki hifazat; hacking, shanakht ki chori, online dhoka-dahi aur data tak be-ijazat rasai, qanooni saza ke saath. Idaron ko data-protection policies bhi apnani hoti hain.

blocks.title: GDPR kahan lagu hai, aur PECA mein baad ki tabdeeli
blocks.text: GDPR un idaron par lagu hai jo European Union ke logon ka zaati data sambhalte hain, un idaron samet jo EU se bahar hain, maslan Pakistani company, magar EU ke logon ko maal ya khidmat dete ya un ke rawaiye ki nigrani karte hain. PECA mein 2025 mein tarmeem hui; taaza shiqon ke liye sarkari matan dekhein.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Rehnuma worksheet se PECA mein shamil cybercrimes ki fehrist banayein.

Computing tawanai use karti, electronic kachra (e-waste) paida karti aur aloodgi mein hissa dalti hai, aur saath hi rabte, rawaiye aur saqafat ko shakal deti hai. E-waste phenke gaye devices hain jaise purane computers, phones, batteries, printers aur chargers; inhein phenkna ya jalana nuqsandeh maddey kharij karta jo mahol aur sehat kharab karte hain. Paidar computing ka matlab technology ko is tarah use, design aur khatam karna hai ke nuqsan kam ho: kam karein (devices zyada der chalayein, tawanai bachane wale chunein), dobara use (marammat, atiya) aur munasib e-waste jama karne walon ke zariye recycle.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Recycling, dobara istemal aur tawanai bachane wale devices mahol ka nuqsan kam karte hain.

Technology badalti hai ke log kaise rabta, kaam aur maloomat hasil karte hain: social media, digital parhai aur online khidmat saqafat aur rozmarra zindagi ko shakal deti, aur taleem, sehat aur karobar behtar karti hain. Yeh masail bhi paida kar sakti hai, jaise rasai rakhne aur na rakhne walon ke darmiyan digital khaleej, aur raazdari ka khatma. In asraat ki samajh soch samajh kar, zimmedarana istemal ko farogh deti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen columns. Akhlaqi: raazdari, insaf aur intellectual property; hacking, jhooti khabar ya cyberbullying nahi. Qanooni: GDPR (European Union) ijazat, rasai aur mitana; PECA 2016 (Pakistan) hacking, shanakht ki chori, dhoka-dahi aur ghair-qanooni rasai. Mahoolyati: tawanai aur e-waste; kam, dobara, aur certified jama karne walon se recycle. Note: technology taleem, sehat aur karobar behtar karti magar digital khaleej barha sakti.
blocks.caption: Computing ke akhlaqi, qanooni aur mahoolyati asraat (9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Aik hi amal teeno columns chhoo sakta hai: paisay wali app copy karna ghair-akhlaqi aur copyright qanoon mein ghair-qanooni hai, aur jis purane phone par chalti thi use kooray mein phenkna mahol ko nuqsan deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Talib-e-ilm na-maloom website se paisay wali kitab ka PDF download kar ke class group mein share karta hai. Is se kaun se akhlaqi, qanooni aur security masail paida hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Akhlaqi aur qanooni: ijazat ke baghair copy aur share kar ke publisher ki intellectual property aur copyright torta hai. Security: na-maloom sites ki files mein malware ho sakta hai jo kholne wale har shakhs tak phail jaye. Sahi amal sarkari ya library nuskha use karna hai.

items: Akhlaqiyat: raazdari, insaf, intellectual property; hacking, jhooti khabar, cyberbullying se parhez.
Qanoon: GDPR (EU) aur PECA 2016 (Pakistan) data bachate aur cybercrime par saza dete.
Mahol aur muashra: e-waste kam, dobara, recycle; digital khaleej aur raazdari ka khayal.
